label: 6 cm
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Macro photograph (453x234) of the inside of a mid-blue trouser waistband with the fly open. Visible: a metal hook-and-bar closure on the waistband extension tab at upper left, zipper teeth running down, the fly shield faced in dark lining with two rows of pale topstitching, and the waistband interior. The extension tab is present, but there is no scale reference and the shot is a steeply foreshortened close-up; my rough check against the roughly 4 cm band height suggests the visible tab is shorter than 6 cm, so the named 6 cm length cannot be confirmed.

references.withheldReason: A hook-and-bar interior shot; evidence states the visible tab is SHORTER than 6 cm and the closure type differs from this option.

references.evidence: Photograph (474x710) of grey flannel bespoke trousers hanging on a wooden hanger against a dark red drapery ground, waistband unfastened. The right-hand waistband extension is folded out toward camera showing its underside and a pointed tab with buttonholes; the left front carries two vertically stacked waistband buttons plus a third button inboard, and cream/checked curtain lining shows inside the open waist. Scaling off the roughly 4.5 cm band height puts the folded-out tab in the 6-7 cm range - plausible for 6 cm but obliquely angled and undimensioned, so not provable.
